June 2026

FYI Yachts is proud to announce the successful sale of the 2023 47′ Freeman, another outstanding transaction that underscores the firm’s continued success in the high-performance center console market.

Raul Faget of FYI Yachts represented both the buyer and the seller, serving as the Listing Broker and Selling Broker for this successful transaction.

Widely regarded as one of the most sought-after offshore center consoles in the industry, the 47′ Freeman is celebrated for its unmatched performance, exceptional ride quality, and innovative catamaran hull design. Built for serious anglers and boating enthusiasts alike, the 47′ Freeman delivers outstanding speed, stability, and versatility while offering premium comfort and craftsmanship.

Representing both sides of the transaction highlights Raul Faget’s market expertise, strong client relationships, and commitment to delivering a seamless brokerage experience from listing to closing.

“Helping both the buyer and seller achieve a successful outcome is always rewarding,” said Raul Faget. “I’m honored to have represented both parties in this transaction. Congratulations to the new owners, and I wish them many unforgettable adventures on the water.”

The FYI Yachts team congratulates everyone involved in the sale and wishes the new owners countless enjoyable days aboard their new 47′ Freeman.

About FYI Yachts

Since 1993, FYI Yachts has been a trusted leader in yacht brokerage, yacht management, charter services, and new construction consulting. With decades of experience and a global network of industry professionals, FYI Yachts continues to provide personalized service while connecting buyers and sellers with exceptional yachting opportunities around the world.

For more information about buying or selling a yacht, visit www.fyiyachts.com
